output.summary: A climbing herb native across southern and central Europe, northwest Africa and western Asia, it has anticlockwise-twining stems, heart-shaped leaves and bright red berries. Most of the plant, including its tuber, is poisonous, but young shoots are reportedly harvested while their saponin content is low and eaten as a vegetable.
